text: Additional metadata-only acquisition check: Mindboggle's official data page explicitly names OSF as its primary repository and links its default data license to CC-BY-4.0 (https://mindboggle.info/data.html; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Klein & Tourville's original paper lists NKI-RS-22 and NKI-TRT-20 as separate groups totaling 42 subjects, with different demographics, but this is not yet a subject-ID overlap audit (https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/neuroscience/articles/10.3389/fnins.2012.00171/full, Table 1). NIREP was checked as a possible independent alternative; its official NITRC page lists noncommercial-only use and no current download releases (https://www.nitrc.org/projects/nirep). No new images were downloaded, no license was accepted, and no fresh-model outputs were inspected. LPBA40/Hammers30 authorization and researcher-details question remains pending; NKI-TRT independence and source/preprocessing checks remain required before sealing qualification blocks.
